notes.title: Breaking Box is participating in the "Indie Game Sale Week" event!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that we are participating in the "Indie Game Sale Week" hosted by the Steam platform! During the "Indie Game Sale Week," Breaking Box will be available at a 30% discount. The discount will be available until November 15th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077510/

Welcome everyone to invite your friends to play and experience Breaking Box together!

notes.title: Recommended multiplayer maps for Multiplayer Game Week
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
The Steam Multiplayer Game Week is about to start on September 28th. During the event, "Breaking Box" will be available at a 30% discount, which will last until the end of the event on October 6th.
During the event, the demo will continue to be freely accessible, and you can create up to 20 maps in online rooms to play with other players. (There are no map restrictions when joining rooms with full versions of the game.)
Feel free to invite your friends to play together.

Recommended multiplayer maps:
[h3]①Variety Show Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Variety" tag to access 20 "Variety Show" maps.
There are no skills required, just see who can last the longest without laughing.Friendship 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/ef23b5f7446be95176bfe28a00495851a2a1bd9a.png[/img]
[h3]②Cooperation Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Cooperation" tag to access 11 "Friendship Cooperation" maps.
The Friendship Cooperation series supports 2 to 8 players for cooperative online play. It is recommended to enable voice chat during multiplayer sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/9b4258306b2cfcb69854577b7b95dd86dfbe61ad.png[/img]
[h3]③JUST UP:[/h3]
When creating a room, the default first map in the list is "JUST UP"
The map has a height of 1000 meters, and it may take some time to load, so please be patient. 
The height of your teammates will be displayed on the right side of the screen.
There are also hidden items in the map, so please avoid hurting your fellow players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/cc8af6e31bfc5c7278f0b4bbc94d85bfab6e3986.png[/img]
[h3] ④Jump Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Rankings" tag to access the maps for bouncing fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/cff69c919bc2cab6a0ed1c33d2fdeccf089ca21e.png[/img]
[h3]⑤Other Brawl Modes:[/h3]
When creating a new room, you can select the "Variety Mode" and "Less Mistakes Mode" tags in the dropdown menu on the left side under "Game Modes" to access different maps for enjoyable gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/75bd342563b0cb7ea0552b8c42d8624d4b3f7676.png[/img]
Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: "Breaking Box" is participating in the "Steam Curator Conference 2023" event!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are participating in the "Steam Curator Conference 2023" organized by the Steam China platform! 
During the "Steam Curator Conference 2023," Breaking Box will be available at a 30% discount. 
As it coincides with Multiplayer Game Week, the discount will be available until October 6th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077510/

We welcome everyone to invite their friends to play Breaking Box together!

[b]Recent Important Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Observer Mode, allowing players to observe ongoing games in the room list and choose whether to join after the game ends.
[*] Added 21 new official multiplayer maps, including variety shows 10-19 and cooperative challenges 01-11, supporting 2-8 players.
[*] Fixed the issue of inconsistent synchronization of jump snap positions during online play.
[*]  In the "Always Upward" multiplayer mode, teammate height indicators have been added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/77d21bd1296c670d805511672e562a5e3db97571.png[/img]

We wish you a pleasant gaming experience!
Improved the text bubbles popup performance.
